scope: Fictional inspection-priority cases, not hydraulic source-location accuracy. All numerical candidates remain conditional; no area is cleared of a leak.
limitations: Author-created synthetic rubric; held_out means excluded from development cases, not external customer validation or an independently authored blind trial.
This separate evaluation harness does not add replay scenarios to the console or override its physical localization gate.
All methods share the same numerical candidates and visible evidence.
Citation/scope checks do not prove semantic entailment; engineer review required.
First priority is not a leak clearance for any deprioritized area.
No geometry improvement, field accuracy, cost savings or universal superiority can be inferred from this suite.
An improved deterministic parser or structured execution data may close gaps.
Zero-candidate answers are code-owned abstentions, with zero LLM calls.
